_comment: New-models-only run (2026-11-09): the LoRAs William added after the first bake-off, on the same five SDXL checkpoints, same 16 prompts, same seed/sampler, so the new columns slot into the sdxl_v1 grids. No-LoRA cells already exist, so include_no_lora is off. The non-SDXL additions (Krea 2 'Ultra Realistic by Stable Yogi', MOSS-Image base + Photographic_realism + its 4-step LoRA, cinematicFantasy (Krea 2), bbeam_comic (FLUX), pinholecamview (unknown)) cannot run in the SDXL graph and are not in this list — see docs/NEXT_MODELS.md. perfect-eyes is limited to portraits.
negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, blurry, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, low quality, jpeg artifacts
